result.title: DMT-Attack: Diffusion-Prior Texture Search for Closed-Loop Vision-Language-Action Policies
result.summary: Vision-language-action (VLA) policies rely on visual feedback throughout manipulation, making them vulnerable to persistent texture attacks. However, optimized patterns can stand out from their surroundings, making an attack easier to notice and its carrier more likely to be inspected or removed. To address this limitation, our key insight is to search the structured image distribution of a diffusion model for natural-looking textures while using closed-loop feedback to identify task-disruptive candidates. Based on this idea, we propose DMT-Attack, a gradient-free gray-box attack that generates textures for ordinary scene objects such as tablecloths. A frozen text-conditioned diffusion model defines the search space, and an eight-expert latent proposal network is initialized from evaluated teacher latents and refined using rollout feedback. We evaluate DMT-Attack against pi_0.5 and OpenVLA-OFT across four LIBERO suites. DMT-Attack achieves a macro clean-conditioned attack success rate (cASR) of 57.9%, compared with 44.7% for UPA-RFAS and 19.7% for random natural textures. It also attains higher scene similarity and a lower clean-calibrated detector flag rate (45% versus 97.5-100% for optimized patch baselines). These results demonstrate that natural-looking textures can disrupt VLA visual feedback and closed-loop decision-making, motivating defenses that jointly assess visual appearance and task behavior.

AI.brief_summary: 提出 DMT-Attack：以冻结的文本条件扩散模型界定自然纹理搜索空间，用八个专家组成的 latent 提议网络从教师 latent 初始化、并借闭环 rollout 反馈精化候选，为桌布等普通物体生成自然外观纹理，在四个 LIBERO 套件上攻击 pi_0.5 与 OpenVLA-OFT，取得高于优化 patch 基线的攻击成功率且更难被检测。
AI.relevance_reason: 其「latent 提议网络 + 闭环 rollout 反馈筛选候选」的梯度无关搜索流程，可供核查能否迁移到 LVR 的多 latent 假设生成与视觉证据筛选；同时结果显示仅自然纹理即可扰乱 VLA 的视觉反馈与闭环决策，或为视觉证据依赖的诊断线索。
